items.title: Clarence Gabriel Interview
items.q: But that's who was playing, because his father was playing trumpet too. And his father, Big Landry, Pinchback, Two Rows.

ctx.x: Did he say if he played dance music or if he played classical or opera or anything?

No, he played nothing but jazzical music. You understand? Through the can-can-finish. He used to play waltz or for a drill. You know all of them, they played that kind of music. Do you remember, was that a B-flat cornet or? It was. It was a B-flat trumpet. A trumpet? Not a trumpet. It was a real cornet. Real cornet. Yeah, short cornet. The trumpets didn't come out until later years. And that was a B-flat horn, B-flat cornet. They called them trumpets around about, when it was the way in the late years of the 20s.…
Did you tell us your father's name, his first name? His first name is Martin. Martin.
